title: SDGs Analysis Consultant
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe SDG Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the project's team and the operational, technical, and communications teams of UN-Habitat Brazil in Rio de Janeiro. He/She may also collaborate with municipal and state government officials, media, and civil society organizations.
Work LocationHome based
Expected durationSeven (7) months
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Program (UN-Habitat) is to promote the sustainable development of human settlements and policies that lead to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners to implement the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient, and connected places, with better opportunities, where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin America and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative and socially fairer urban economic, social and environmental policies. UN-Habitat initiated a project with the State Government of Rio de Janeiro (Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – GERJ) that aims to strengthen urban resilience in the State of Rio de Janeiro based on the implementation of the 2030 Agenda and the New Urban Agenda principles. The project Inclusive and Sustainable Rio helps the State to achieve urban prosperity while implementing global sustainable urban development agendas. In particular, the proposal focuses on increasing its urban resilience through the development of disaster prevention and mitigation actions. The "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit" is part of the Inclusive and Sustainable Rio initiative. Its primary byproduct is a report aiming at providing technical guidance, building local capacities, being a tool to strengthen connections, alliances and collaboration between local and state governments focused on the review of the implementation of the SDGs and the Agenda 2030 locally. To support the implementation of this project and UN-Habitat's mandate in Brazil, an SDGs Analysis Consultant is required to work on the "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit". Report to UN-Habitat Manager The SDGs Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The SDG Analysis Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Write a report concerning the a regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. b) Analyse the data and systematise it according to the characteristics of the regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. c) Visit selected regional territorial unit to validate the information and discuss priority projects. d) Prepare and organize participatory technical workshops. e) Provide, when possible, an integrated perspective on basic urban services such as housing, mobility, energy, water, sanitation, etc. and their vulnerability to extreme weather events. f) Support reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. g) Be responsible for maintaining an organized and accessible information file. h) Maintain close communication with counterparts and local partners, such as the governments, civil society organizations, universities, private sector, etc. i) Be responsible for ensuring that all activities observe the principles of integrity of the United Nations. j) Participate in weekly virtual meetings—and occasionally in-person meetings—held during regular working hours throughout the product development phase, upon request. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The SDGs Analysis Consultant shall assist in the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Situation Analysis Report Description: The situational analysis serves as a diagnostic of existing data and policies and their alignment with the SDGs, with the aim of establishing subnational coherence with the 2030 Agenda and identifying opportunities for action. The Situation Analysis Report must contain: (i) collection of information to identify indicators, policies and instruments related to the objectives of the VLR; (ii) alignment with the SDGs and other measurement tools for tracking progress towards the 2030 Agenda; (iii) availability and identification of data sources to assess data accessibility, quality, and availability, preferably disaggregated by population subgroups and geographic areas; (iv) prioritization and selection of indicators; (v) analysis of secondary data and policies, including, where possible, an assessment of their alignment with the VLR objectives, while highlighting successes, gaps and areas for potential improvement; and (vi) mapping of relevant stakeholders. The Situation Analysis Report will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 90 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) must contain: (i) in-person workshops for stakeholders to assess the Situation Analysis Report of the VLR; (ii) complete review and analysis of all collected data and its relation to the SDGs; (iii) strategic vision for the state government, considering the collected evidence to understand the current status of the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iv) recommendations to achieve the SDGs, establishing specific actions and paths to achieve the SDGs, filling the existing gaps identified. The output will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 120 days after signing the contract. Product 3 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (final version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit (final version) must contain: (i) consolidation of deliverables (products 1 and 2), adjusting to the revisions requested by the UN-Habitat team and the Government of Rio de Janeiro; (ii) in-person workshops for stakeholders to present the preliminary content of the VLR and strengthen institutional capacities to implement the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iii) an executive summary synthesizing the overall performance of government policies within the SDGs, key findings, recommendations, and challenges to strengthen the localization of the policies. The output will consist of two separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction, an executive summary of up to five pages, and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. All volumes must follow the templates adopted by UN-Habitat. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Additional formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 180 days after signing the contract.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation Required:
Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required.
Postgraduate degree (Latu Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
A minimum of six (6) years of professional experience in Urban and Regional Planning, working within or in close collaboration with public administration at the federal, state, and/or municipal levels, is required.
Experience in work involving knowledge of and engagement with Brazil's National Urban and Environmental Policies, particularly their respective instruments, is required.
Experience in work related to international, national, and subnational good practices on Voluntary Local Reviews (VLRs) is required.
Experience in public policy analysis and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), with demonstrated expertise in intersectoral approaches, monitoring and evaluation, and the analysis and development of indicators and scenarios is required.
Previous experience in social mobilization and participatory activities involving public officials, civil servants, and civil society is required.
Professional or academic experience — such as research positions — in urban-environmental public policy and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is required.
Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
Proficiency in technological tools such as Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word), and referencing and formatting tools such as Bib Tex is required.
Exceptional narrative report writing and editing skills, as well as proficient use of Brazilian Portuguese, are required.
Knowledge and experience in qualitative and quantitative analysis of socioeconomic indicators are required.
Knowledge and experience in handling databases from Population Censuses, administrative records, and other statistical surveys are required.
Previous research experience aligned with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the New Urban Agenda is desirable.
Knowledge and experience with the administrative divisions and territorial organization of the State of Rio de Janeiro are desirable.
Good command of programming and data analysis in R software is desirable.
Good handling of online event and conference tools is desirable.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competency:
Professionalism: experience working in inter-institutional environments; project management; monitoring and evaluation; and the development of approaches and strategies related to good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and Organization: professional approach to work and a strong sense of responsibility, with the ability to operate independently. Proven organizational skills and the capacity to manage workload efficiently and meet established deadlines.
Communication: ability to write clearly and effectively; actively listen and interpret messages accurately; respond appropriately; demonstrate openness in sharing information and keep relevant stakeholders informed. Strong abstract reasoning skills and a proven ability to produce written materials tailored to diverse audiences.
Teamwork: ability to work collaboratively within teams; demonstrate leadership, conflict resolution, and consensus-building skills; work effectively in multicultural and multi-ethnic environments while respecting diversity. Demonstrates sensitivity to the mainstreaming of vulnerability and a willingness and ability to operate in challenging contexts. Knowledge Management:
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and Spanish is desirable.

title: Analista de BI Sênior
description:
Missão do Cargo
Atuar na coleta, tratamento, modelagem e análise de dados, transformando informações brutas em insights estratégicos por meio de relatórios, dashboards e indicadores, garantindo qualidade, governança e confiabilidade dos dados para apoio à tomada de decisão.
Requisitos e Responsabilidades
Modelagem e Banco de Dados
Desenvolver, manter e otimizar consultas em SQL Server, utilizando CTEs, subqueries, window functions e boas práticas de performance e otimização de queries.

Garantir integridade, consistência e desempenho dos modelos de dados.
Integração e Engenharia de Dados
Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Azure Data Factory, atuando em processos de ETL/ELT.
Integrar dados provenientes de diferentes fontes, assegurando qualidade e padronização.
Monitorar e corrigir falhas nos processos de carga e transformação de dados.
Análises, Indicadores e Visualização

Definir, calcular e acompanhar KPIs e indicadores de negócio, alinhados às necessidades das áreas.
Aplicar conceitos de estatística descritiva para análise e interpretação dos dados.
Qualidade e Governança de Dados
Avaliar e monitorar a qualidade dos dados, identificando inconsistências, dados ausentes e outliers.
Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados, garantindo rastreabilidade, padronização e confiabilidade das informações.
Realizar controle de versionamento de scripts e modelos utilizando ferramentas como Git.
Documentação, Suporte e Melhoria Contínua
Elaborar e manter documentação de BI, incluindo regras de negócio, dicionário de dados e fluxos de informação.
Apoiar usuários e áreas de negócio na interpretação dos dados e uso das soluções de BI.
Sugerir e implementar melhorias contínuas nos processos, modelos e visualizações de dados.

Experiência prática com Flutter e Dart (profissional ou equivalente que comprove entregas reais).

Experiência com recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics e Remote Config.
Conhecimento de Git e rotina de pull request/code review (mesmo que com apoio).
Noções sólidas de qualidade: organização de código, tratamento de erros e atenção a performance.
Conhecimento básico de testes em Flutter (unit/widget) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento mobile.

Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização

Experiência com CI/CD mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps).
Noções de observabilidade e monitoramento em apps.
Experiência com app em produção (mesmo que em menor escala).
Informações adicionais

Muita visibilidade e exposição positiva, pra você conseguir se conectar com todo mundo sem muita hierarquia.

title: Coordenador de Polos EAD
description:
Descrição da Empresa e vaga
Se você busca um desafio robusto, com impacto real e conexão direta com o universo da educação, esta pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade.
O Instituto Primeira Geração (PriG) está conduzindo o processo seletivo para uma empresa do setor educacional, em parceria com uma instituição de ensino de grande porte, reconhecida pela qualidade acadêmica, foco em resultados e excelência na experiência do aluno.
Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Polos EAD, com perfil de liderança, forte capacidade de execução e visão sistêmica, para atuar na coordenação de polos na região metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.
Sobre a Oportunidade
Esta posição é ideal para profissionais que gostam de liderar a operação no front, garantindo eficiência, qualidade e consistência nos fluxos acadêmicos, comerciais e administrativos.
O desafio envolve a gestão simultânea de múltiplos polos, exigindo maturidade de execução, capacidade de priorização e leitura estratégica de indicadores em um ambiente dinâmico, com diferentes frentes de atuação acontecendo em paralelo.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Nesta posição, você será responsável por:
· Gerir operacionalmente um núcleo de polos EAD, garantindo o cumprimento de metas acadêmicas, comerciais e de atendimento.
· Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (captação, evasão, satisfação, desempenho acadêmico, entre outros) e propor planos de ação para melhoria contínua;
· Apoiar e supervisionar as equipes locais (atendimento, tutoria, captação e infraestrutura), promovendo engajamento e desenvolvimento;
· Garantir a conformidade acadêmica e administrativa dos polos, em alinhamento com as políticas e padrões da instituição de ensino parceira;
· Conduzir reuniões periódicas com equipes e gestores da instituição parceira, apresentando resultados e iniciativas;
· Planejar e executar ações de captação e relacionamento, em parceria com os times de marketing e comercial;
· Atuar de forma estratégica na experiência do aluno, desde o ingresso até a conclusão do curso.
Requisitos e qualificações
Obrigatórios:
· Alinhamento com o propósito do Instituto Primeira Geração: ter sido a primeira geração da família a concluir o ensino superior;
· Graduação em Administração, Gestão Educacional, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
· Experiência prévia em coordenação, supervisão ou liderança de equipes operacionais;
· Vivência prática com acompanhamento de indicadores, controle de processos e tomada de decisão orientada por dados;
· Domínio de ferramentas de produtividade, como planilhas de controle, relatórios gerenciais e dashboards;
· Capacidade de organização, priorização e execução com precisão;
· Soft skills essenciais: senso de dono, proatividade, liderança, comunicação clara, pensamento crítico e adaptabilidade.
Desejáveis (diferenciais):
· Pós-graduação em Gestão Educacional, Administração ou áreas afins;
· Visão estratégica aplicada à operação;
· Experiência com processos comerciais e ações de captação;
· Familiaridade com plataformas de EAD (AVA), sistemas acadêmicos e CRM.

title: Coordenador(a) de Tesouraria
description:
Descrição da vaga
Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.
Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.
Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade.
O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também.
Porque na Norsul, pertencer é saber que sua atuação ajuda a sustentar um negócio essencial para o país — e uma cultura feita por gente que se importa.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Responsável por coordenar as atividades de tesouraria da empresa, garantindo a adequada gestão do caixa, fluxo de caixa, capital de giro, endividamento e instrumentos financeiros. Atua no planejamento financeiro de curto e médio prazo, assegurando liquidez, otimização do custo financeiro e cumprimento das obrigações financeiras. Responsável pelo relacionamento com instituições financeiras, negociação de operações de crédito, garantias e câmbio, bem como pelo controle de riscos financeiros e aderência às políticas internas.
Assegura a liquidez e previsibilidade de caixa, equilibrando custo financeiro, risco e suporte às decisões estratégicas do negócio;
Liderar a equipe, desenvolvendo competências, promovendo engajamento, garantindo clareza de responsabilidades e fortalecendo a cultura de controles e confiabilidade das informações;
Coordenar a execução dos processos de pagamentos, dos compromissos financeiros, a serem realizados, no país e no exterior, de acordo com os procedimentos e normas estabelecidas. Mantendo controle dos compromissos financeiros da empresa, confiabilidade e validação do processo de pagamento, dos lançamentos financeiros e contábeis;
Coordenar o fechamento de câmbio em diversas moedas, analisando documentação/sistema e intermediando, por meio da corretora, o pagamento dos compromissos. Assegurando o cumprimento dos compromissos perante os fornecedores no exterior;
Monitorar exposições a riscos de mercado (câmbio, juros, commodities) e propor estratégias de mitigação;
Manter controle da movimentação bancária diária, apurando saldos e lançamentos bancários, garantindo a validação do fluxo de caixa através do acompanhamento, análise e atualização do fluxo de caixa realizado e previsto;
Contatar fornecedores e instituições financeiras para solução de pendências relacionadas a pagamentos;
Assessorar a gerência quanto com relação as demandas da Diretoria;
Aplicar ou resgatar os recursos necessários a operação da empresa;
Executar o processo de pagamento dos financiamentos do BNDES;
Gerir o relacionamento com bancos e instituições financeiras, negociando limites, tarifas, linhas de crédito e serviços;
Coordenar operações de crédito, garantias bancárias, fianças, cartas de crédito e instrumentos similares;
Avaliar e propor novas estruturas financeiras, buscando melhores condições de custo e prazo;
Controlar o endividamento da companhia, acompanhando saldo, cronograma de amortização, juros e covenants;
Analisar e reportar indicadores de alavancagem, custo da dívida e exposição financeira;
Apoiar processos de captação, rolagem, renegociação ou liquidação de dívidas;
Auxiliar usuários do Microsiga (Protheus) no modulo financeiro quando solicitado.
Requisitos e qualificações
Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, ou afins;
Experiência em rotinas de tesouraria, conciliação bancária, contas a pagar e receber, gestão financeira, fluxo de caixa, pagamentos internacionais, Pagamentos FMM/BNDES, garantias bancárias (fiança) e aplicações financeiras;
Fluxo de caixa direto e indireto, investimentos financeiros, cotações de taxas financeiras, análise de investimento câmbio, produtos financeiros, elaboração de relatórios gerenciais.
Informações adicionais
Benefícios que oferecemos
Plano de saúde e odonto
Wellhub (atividade física e bem-estar)
Atendimento psicológico (Telavita)
Nutricionista
Shiatsu
Ticket alimentação/refeição
Cultura de desenvolvimento contínuo
Programas internos de reconhecimento e cuidado
Auxílio creche
Day off de aniversário
PLR
Fazer parte
É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer.
Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias.
Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.
A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.
Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.
Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.
Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.
Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor.
Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega.

title: Programa de Jovem Aprendiz
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.
Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.
Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).

Um mergulho no mundo da siderurgia com conteúdos teóricos e práticos, pensado para desenvolver talentos, formar futuros profissionais e preparar sucessores para posições operacionais. É a sua oportunidade de crescer junto com a gente e moldar o amanhã

Jovens entre 18 e 21 anos (diretriz da empresa);
Estar cursando ou já ter concluído o Ensino Médio;

Incentivamos fortemente a participação de mulheres e pessoas com deficiência

title: Assistente de Renovação Governo
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está há mais de 20 anos no mercado, que não apenas é parceira premier do Google Cloud, mas também já foi 5 vezes premiada como Partner of the year? Uma empresa que além de ser fera naquilo que faz, também valoriza e leva a sério o compromisso com cada IPNETER, possuindo há 6 anos consecutivos o selo Great Place To Work. Pois é, essa empresa existe. Essa empresa é a IPNET by Vivo Além disso, somos comprometidos com a inclusão, abraçando cada forma única de ser humano, independente de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, habilidades físicas ou mentais. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, não apenas reconhecemos, mas também celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time. E, estamos com uma vaga aberta para Assistente de Renovação. Governo , que irá atuar dentro do nosso time de Growth Team , sendo responsável por:Atuar no processo de Renovação contratual dos clientes do segmento Governo. Alinhar com os Customer Experience Managers (CXMs) previamente as estratégias/ações em cada conta. Entrar em contato com os clientes por telefone e meet (reuniões) ou e-mail. Manter bom relacionamento com cliente, se posicionando como ponto focal para resolução de dificuldades. Arquivar e organizar os contratos e propostas oriundos do processo de renovação da empresa. Confecção e envio de propostas, contratos e aditivos. Acompanhamento do processo, controle dos prazos de renovação. Criar contrato de renovação no ERP (Sankhya) e também no de fornecedores. Atualização cadastral no ERP (Sankhya) e CRM (Pipedrive). Atender os pedidos de cancelamento, buscando reverter os casos. Realizar cancelamento de paineis Google Workspace, Google Cloud, Google Maps. Interagir com o time de renovação Google para adquirir as condições comerciais e aplicar as ofertas. Cadastrar oportunidades CRM interno (Pipedrive) e do fornecedor (Partner Advantage-Google). Conversão de oportunidades em novos contratos. Entendemos que para atender as demandas da vaga, é necessário que o candidato possua:Cursando o ensino superior ou com formação completa em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Tecnologia da Informação e áreas correlacionadas. Experiência com CRM e ERP (Pipedrive e Sankhya). Experiência no relacionamento com clientes, Googlers (FSRs e PDMs) e IPNETers (CXMs, vendedores e equipe financeira). Compreensão de processos licitatórios e sua aplicação prática. Na IPNET, acreditamos no trabalho híbrido como forma de fortalecer nossa cultura e acelerar nosso engajamento, respeitando, ao mesmo tempo, a flexibilidade. Por essa razão, nossa proposta consiste em trabalhar 2X na semana home-office e 3X presencialmente no escritório. Atualmente, contamos com dois escritórios no Brasil:um no Rio de Janeiro (Zona Portuária/Santo Cristo) e outro em São Paulo (Cidade Monções). Reconhecemos a importância dos benefícios, e por isso, nosso pacote contempla:Auxílio Refeição/Alimentação Auxílio Transporte Plano de Saúde Plano Odontológico Auxílio Home-Office Wellhub Seguro de Vida Auxílio Creche/Babá Happy Day no mês do seu aniversário Parcerias com instituições educacionais, tanto de idiomas quanto acadêmicas Se você se identificou com os requisitos descritos acima, não pense 2 vezes. Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que abraça a inovação e onde o caos não assusta, porque somos um time que joga junto, possui um papo reto e uma cabeça de dono .

Na Ipiranga acreditamos que pessoas com brilho nos olhos, autênticas e engajadas são nosso diferencial competitivo Atuamos com paixão e propósito, colocando o cliente no centro das nossas decisões. Valorizamos a autonomia, a abertura e a transparência, pois temos certo de que a verdade e o respeito fortalecem relações e geram confiança. Proporcionamos para nosso time um ambiente flexível, de colaboração e bem-estar para plena realização pessoal e profissional. Nosso propósito é "Abastecer a vida em movimento".

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Missão:
A Ipiranga está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Mercado Marítimo para liderar o desenvolvimento e a gestão de negócios no segmento de combustíveis marítimos, atendendo grandes operadores do mercado offshore de óleo e gás, transportadores fluviais e embarcações de apoio. Garantir soluções integradas e customizadas que unam fornecimento de combustível, serviços e infraestrutura, com foco em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e excelência no relacionamento com clientes estratégicos
Atividades e Responsabilidades
• Desenvolver e implementar estratégias comerciais para ampliar a participação no mercado de combustíveis marítimos.
• Atender e expandir relacionamento com grandes operadores offshore de óleo e gás, empresas de transporte fluvial e operadores de embarcações de apoio.
• Identificar e estruturar oportunidades de novos negócios, parcerias e soluções diferenciadas para clientes estratégicos.
• Negociar contratos complexos de fornecimento de combustíveis e serviços logísticos, assegurando competitividade e sustentabilidade do negócio.
• Acompanhar performance dos contratos (volumes, margens, indicadores de satisfação) e implementar planos de ação para melhorias.
• Atuar em conjunto com áreas técnicas, operacionais e de logística para garantir a excelência na entrega e na experiência do cliente.
• Monitorar tendências de mercado, concorrência, cenários regulatórios e oportunidades relacionadas à transição energética no setor marítimo.
• Gestão de Equipe: Liderar, treinar, engajar e desenvolver a equipe garantindo alta performance e evolução individual.
• Aprimoramento de Processos: Mapear e eliminar gargalos da operação, implementando rotinas, rituais de gestão e boas práticas comerciais.
• Inovação e Tecnologia: Atuar fortemente no uso de ferramentas digitais, CRM e automação para garantir escalabilidade e previsibilidade no funil de vendas.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
Pré requisitos:
• Formação superior em Engenharia
• Experiência consolidada em gestão comercial B2B, com atuação em combustíveis, óleo & gás, logística marítima ou offshore.
• Vivência comprovada no relacionamento com clientes do setor marítimo (offshore, fluvial, apoio portuário ou navegação), com entregas consistentes.
• Habilidade de comunicação, negociação e influência em todos os níveis.
• Conhecimento em gestão de contratos complexos e negociações de alto impacto.
• Perfil estratégico, com capacidade de execução e orientação para resultados.
• Vivência com CRM e ferramentas de automação de vendas.
• Inglês avançado.
Competências Comportamentais
• Visão estratégica com foco em geração de valor para clientes e empresa.
• Forte habilidade de negociação e gestão de relacionamentos de longo prazo.
• Capacidade de articulação com diferentes stakeholders internos e externos.
• Proatividade e resiliência em ambiente de alta complexidade e pressão.
• Mentalidade inovadora, voltada para soluções logísticas e energéticas sustentáveis.
Diferenciais:
• Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Comercial, Energia, Logística ou áreas relacionadas.
• Experiência no setor B2B (energia, combustíveis, logística, tecnologia ou serviços).
• Rede de relacionamento consolidada no segmento offshore e fluvial.
Perfil desejado
• Mentalidade de crescimento (growth mindset): alguém que desafia o status quo, busca inovação e não se limita a manter o atual.
• Forte viés analítico: capacidade de interpretar dados para tomada de decisão estratégica.

description:
Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências.
Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.
Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Consultor(a) Sênior de Valuation no time de Valuation & Modeling. Na sua rotina, você irá:
Selecionar métodos apropriados para avaliação econômico-financeira de empresas ou ativos, levantando e analisando informações relevantes para a avaliação;

Cumprir com padrões de qualidade, regras de risco e confidencialidade, e diretrizes para entregar resultados;
Coordenar as atividades da equipe de trabalho dando suporte técnico para a execução das atividades dos analistas;
Atuar no desenvolvimento técnico dos analistas ministrando treinamentos formais e realizando treinamentos on-the-job;
Realizar um trabalho de alta qualidade e colaborar com as demais áreas envolvidas no projeto em que estiver alocado para entregar um trabalho de excelência e integrado respeitando os padrões de qualidade da Deloitte.
Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

title: Designer – Branding Focus for Marketing Team
description:
About Lumenalta
At Lumenalta, we create impactful software solutions that drive innovation and transform businesses. Since 2000, we've partnered with visionary leaders to build cutting-edge technology, solve complex challenges, and deliver faster results through our elite teams and tech-driven approach. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
Your Role
As a Designer focused on Branding & Visual Strategy, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our marketing efforts through compelling and cohesive design strategies. Your primary goal will be to align business objectives with user-centered design principles, creating impactful visual assets, motion graphics, and experiences that resonate with our audience and elevate engagement.
Responsibilities
Collaborate with the marketing team to define business goals and translate them into innovative and strategic branding solutions.
Develop and maintain brand guidelines to ensure consistency across all visual, digital, and motion touchpoints.
Design assets for web, mobile, and other marketing channels, leveraging tools like Figma to create wireframes, prototypes, and final designs.
Create motion graphics and video content to enhance storytelling and brand communication.
Conduct user research and gather feedback to refine designs, ensuring alignment with end-user expectations and business objectives.
Formulate and drive the internal visual design strategy to ensure excellence and cohesion across all creative outputs.
Handle complex use cases involving large-scale audiences and multiple interdependencies.
Iterate designs based on data insights, feedback, and emerging trends to enhance brand visibility and user engagement.
Your Team
You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and marketers. This role requires the ability to:
Act as a bridge between business goals and design execution.
Quickly understand and translate abstract concepts into tangible designs.
Independently manage branding projects while collaborating with team members to meet deadlines and objectives.
Requirements
7+ years of professional experience with a portfolio showcasing branding expertise, visual strategy, motion graphics, and versatility across mediums.
Senior-level experience: At least 4 years of experience designing digital products, marketing campaigns, and video content across web, mobile, and other platforms.

title: Product Designer II, Grocery
description:
About The Role
We're looking for a product designer to join the Merchant Success team for Grocery & Retail at Uber Eats. As part of this team, you'll play a key role in building trust with merchants through new capabilities like reporting and insights, disbursements, invoicing, and more to help them run their business successfully.
At Uber, Product Designers tackle challenges and work on big new ideas that will transform how people use our products. In a rapidly growing environment, you'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, content designers and some of the world's best designers and researchers. Uber Design makes magic by crafting and shipping delightful experiences for people around the globe.
What The Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points
---- What the Candidate Will Do ----
Onboard to the Uber Design team: Learn how we collaborate and use design tools, how to design with the Uber Base design system, and how we design for clarity, inclusion, accessibility, scalability, and global localization.
Onboard to your product area: Meet your cross-functional stakeholders, learn about their business goals and strategy, get familiar with existing tech platforms, and understand your team's product development and launch review process.
Scope: Work on projects of all sizes, from problems that are well-known to those more complex and conceptual, while leading a roadmap in your product area.
Process: Build a deep understanding of the users you are designing for through data and research, lead the end-to-end design process, solicit and incorporate feedback from experts, translate your designs to build with engineers, and work flexibly with a variety of teams. Design at all levels of fidelity, thoroughly explore the problem space, and practice good judgment on making tradeoffs.
Craft: Turn big ideas into simple, elegant products. Ship features that are effective and easy to use. Deliver designs that are innovative and scalable. Document design frameworks such that others can build upon your solutions. Have a strong understanding of business, data, and engineering requirements, and create experiences that deliver real customer value.
Efficiency: Prioritize and manage your time efficiently, operate with high autonomy, manage several concurrent projects at once, and collaborate effectively.
Communication: Communicate with clarity and persuasiveness, and effectively present your work and rationale to all the relevant stakeholders. Proactively communicate with your team and manager, facilitate design sessions, and collaborate with other designers. Maintain honest and trusting relationships with your team.
Influence: Lead team activities through ideas, organization, and execution. Supports internal initiatives to improve the Design team. Share your skills and learnings with other team members.
Basic Qualifications
3+ years of Product Design experience
Experience building products for mobile apps, tablets, and web interfaces
A portfolio showing your high-quality, thoughtful UI and UX work
Fluent/Advanced English skills
Preferred Qualifications
Proficiency with Figma or similar tools and prototyping methods
Experience working with user experience researchers and various methods of research
Experience working and collaborating in a tech environment
Shipped many successful software products, ideally both mobile and desktop
Highly proficient in storytelling and prototyping
Ability to strongly articulate your design work and rationale to your peers and cross-functional team
Experience designing with large-scale design systems and frameworks

Somos uma empresa inclusiva e diversa, cheia de oportunidades de crescimento, clima alegre e descontraído.

Coordenar a arrumação, precificação, validade dos produtos e atendimento aos clientes em toda área do Checkout;

Curtiu? Então candidate-se e venha trabalhar conosco
Conheça mais sobre a Casa&Video
A CASA&VIDEO faz parte do Grupo CVLB, que nasceu em abril de 2023, fruto da fusão com outra gigante do varejo, a Le biscuit.
Com a união dos dois negócios, nos tornamos ainda maiores. Hoje somos cerca de 5 mil colaboradores trabalhando diariamente para tornar a vida das famílias mais feliz. Temos uma capilaridade ainda maior, com as duas bandeiras CASA&VIDEO e Le biscuit, estamos presentes em mais de 14 estados, temos 2 centros de distribuição e atendemos mais de 35 milhões de clientes por ano.
Com uma forte presença no Rio de Janeiro, a bandeira CASA&VIDEO possui mais de 220 lojas na Região Sudeste (RJ, ES, MG e SP) e atende mais de 20 milhões de clientes por ano. A marca conta com uma plataforma física, com diferentes modelos de lojas, um ecossistema de vendas digitais e um portfólio de serviços financeiros e marcas próprias que se complementam. Oferecemos aos nossos clientes os mais diversos produtos, a preços acessíveis, para equipar a casa e surpreender a família brasileira.
O nosso sonho grande é dobrar o tamanho da companhia em 5 anos, de forma rentável, surpreendendo os nossos clientes. E ai, você quer vir escrever essa história de sucesso junto com a gente?
Acompanhe todas as nossas vagas abertas e siga as nossas redes sociais para ficar por dentro de tudo o que rola por aqui.

title: Senior Manager, Hospitality Stakeholder Services
description:
Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Sitting within the Ticketing & Hospitality Department, Hospitality (along with Ticketing) aims to deliver the most engaging, and innovative Women's World Cup experience for all partners, customers, guests and the FIFA football family.
Reporting organizationally to the Head of FWWC27 Hospitality Operations, the Senior Manager Hospitality Stakeholder Services will help serve Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 that is hosting 32 teams across 8 venues.
This role will be responsible for the overall management of hospitality stakeholder servicing across the 8 host cities, ensuring an exceptional and consistent guest experience to FIFA's Affiliates and their guests throughout the tournament.
Further, this role will oversee a wide range of responsibilities, including the operational management and delivery of the Affiliates Hospitality Programme in accordance with contractual obligations, as well as ensuring the servicing of key stakeholders (such as FIFA's Commercial Partners, Licensees and Media Partners), in close collaboration with FIFA HQ, FIFA's Official Hospitality Provider, the stadium authorities and other relevant stakeholders, ensuring a consistently high-quality and professional delivery.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Oversee, in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, the execution of the Affiliates hospitality programme across all stadiums of the FIFA Women's World Cup 27
In close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, plan and execute FIFA Affiliates' hospitality activations, ensuring their requirements are met and delivering on sponsorship and other contractual obligations.
Monitor and ensure FIFA's Affiliates contractual rights are delivered and observed across the implementation of the entire FIFA Hospitality Programme.
In close collaboration with FIFA Zurich and the Official Hospitality Provider, ensures contractual hospitality allocation planning, delivery, and fulfilment.
Ensures operational readiness & delivery of the FIFA Affiliates Hospitality programme, across all venues, validating maps & plans, drawings, staffing plans and coordinating all operational communication with FIFA's Affiliates and their agencies.
Manage the FIFA Hospitality Stakeholder Team responsible for the on-the ground execution of the FIFA Affiliates Hospitality Programme across all venues.
Develop and implement comprehensive affiliates hospitality venue operations plans and strategies that align with the tournament's objectives and deliver exceptional guest experiences.
Ensure effective coordination and collaboration with and between stakeholders, including FIFA, the Official Hospitality Provider, FIFA's Affiliates, and other relevant parties.
Manage cross-divisional communication and service level agreements for the implementation of on-site affiliates hospitality requirements and services, ensuring deliveries to the highest standards and in respect to contractual obligations.
Prepare and present comprehensive reports on FIFA Affiliates hospitality operations, including performance metrics and recommendations for future events.
Organize and attends FIFA Affiliates' Hospitality-specific site visits and workshops.
Coordinate Affiliates branding permits and approvals.
Responsible for hospitality parking allocation, requests, and fulfilment for FIFA's Affiliates.
Monitors and ensures the implementation of clean site obligations in Hospitality areas in close collaboration with FIFA's rights delivery team and the Official Hospitality Provider.
Prepares end of tournament reports on the FIFA Affiliates Hospitality Programme.
YOUR PROFILE
Bachelor's Degree or similar level of education in Hospitality Management, Events Project Management, Marketing, etc.
Minimum of 8 years of work experience in hospitality and/or sponsorship management, preferably for major sports events.
Proven experience in managing multiple stakeholders, events, and venues simultaneously.
Proven experience with event hospitality and ticketing
Ability to lead, manage, and motivate a team
Proven project management experience
International business profile is a must
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer-service attitude, even when under pressure.
Ability to work independently and in a team across simultaneous work streams.
Exquisite organizational skills.
Ability to lead, manage, and motivate a team.
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
Good knowledge of AutoCad and literacy of architectural drawings
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas

A GuidelineIT está crescendo e buscamos alguém para assumir a fila de suporte com padrão, organização e responsabilidade. Você vai atuar majoritariamente no atendimento remoto e no escritório, com visitas pontuais a clientes (1–2x/semana) para resolver demandas presenciais ou apoiar projetos.
A missão é simples e rara no mercado: resolver bem, registrar bem e reduzir escaladas, liberando o time sênior para projetos, automação e melhorias.

Atender e resolver chamados (incidentes e solicitações) via Service Desk, WhatsApp, telefone e suporte remoto.
Conduzir o ticket do início ao fim: diagnóstico, solução, validação com o usuário e fechamento com registro claro.

title: Analista em Segurança da Informação
description:

Projetar e implementar arquitetura de segurança, promovendo as melhores práticas e definindo controles de segurança de forma a proteger os dados e sistemas contra ameaças cibernéticas. Realizar avaliações de risco, desenvolvendo políticas de segurança, identificando e priorizando vulnerabilidades e falhas de controles, propondo correções, mitigações e mantendo-se atualizado sobre as últimas ameaças e tendências de segurança para fortalecer continuamente a postura de Segurança da Informação.
Realizar análise especializada de Segurança da Informação, destacando-se a definição técnica e execução das atividades a seguir:
Análise dos ambientes corporativo, nuvem, automação industrial e automação predial para propor e definir arquiteturas e controles de proteção.
Elaboração de políticas e arquiteturas focadas em segurança cibernética.
Especificações técnicas de soluções e procedimentos.
Identificação de lacunas e propostas de melhorias em políticas e arquitetura de segurança.
Análise de novas tecnologias para elevar a maturidade de segurança.
Avaliações de boas práticas e benchmarkings comparando com empresas e institutos de pesquisa.
Relatórios e apresentações de Segurança da Informação para diversas soluções.
Pesquisas e provas de conceito em Segurança da Informação.
Pareceres de Segurança da Informação para projetos e sistemas, assegurando conformidade com normas.
Consultoria de Segurança da Informação para projetos e sistemas, assegurando conformidade com normas.
Análise de risco de inovação de Segurança da Informação para projetos e sistemas, assegurando conformidade com normas.
Suporte técnico a projetos e processos de Telecomunicações.
Recomendações e revisões de configurações e arquitetura de segurança.
Avaliação de segurança e análise de risco para liberação de URLs, domínios, regras de firewall, e-mails etc.
Avaliação da qualidade do filtro de e-mails para ajuste de falsos positivos/negativos.
Suporte e melhorias nos processos de gestão de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de patches e baseline de segurança.
Verificação do escopo dos controles e suporte na definição de estratégias de aprimoramento.
Análise de vulnerabilidades em ativos corporativos e revisão de planos de remediação.
Colaboração com outras equipes para remoção de entraves e automação de tarefas.
Colaboração e participação com outras equipes para implantação de soluções tecnológicas.
Arquitetura de conformidade e gerenciamento de riscos, recomendando controles e ações corretivas.
Monitoramento e gestão de exposição e análise de critérios para tratamento e priorização de vulnerabilidades.
Acompanhamento e reporte de resultados das atividades de gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de patches.
Arquitetura de análise de dados de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de patches para identificação de anomalias.

Arquitetura de perícia digital.
Arquitetura de Inteligência contra ameaças, monitorando e analisando ameaças emergentes para antecipar e mitigar riscos, além de fornecer insights para fortalecer a postura de segurança.
Realização de viagens para avaliação de eficácia de controles in loco.

title: Process Eng.
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands-on expertise in Utilities processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD) under Global Manufacturing (GM) Excellence Organization.
OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to GM operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.
Your primary is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for Utilities, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support and benchmarking of utilities.
Key Responsibilities:
As successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Conduct regular performance reviews of existing Utilities through key performance indicators (KPIs) representing optimum operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates) and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including process design, troubleshooting, start-up/shutdown activities, and capacity test runs.
Provide detailed service reports for each support activity, highlighting facility needs, actions taken, results, and lessons learned.
Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization or process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low-hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment, through operational adjustment or design modification.
Conduct internal assessments on Utilities using Saudi Aramco engineering standard references and highlight any deviations or better standards applied by affiliates for endorsement to facility management or Saudi Aramco Central Engineering.
Act as the overall coordinator for cascading and driving Global Manufacturing and Corporate programs for Utilities in operating facilities, enabling their execution and effective monitoring.
Participate in Business Plan development, coordinate with stakeholders for capital investments on assigned Utilities and support techno-economic evaluations.
Evaluate and recommend new Utilities technologies, coordinate with Central Engineering to facilitate field deployment.
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred.
You will have a minimum of 15 years of total Utilities unit experience (process engineering and operations) with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in handling refinery's utilities.
You will have experience in water desalination and boilers for steam generation
You will be able to optimize various utility systems, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
You will have in-depth knowledge of major equipment suppliers and package units for Utilities.
You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start-up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for utility systems.
You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Utilities performance metrics.
You will also have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management.
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Senior Project Controls Specialist
description:
Job Description
Job Overview:
The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.
Responsibilities
Key Tasks and Responsibilities:
Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive-level reporting
Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi-phase projects
Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi-dimensional models that support real-time decision-making
Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long-term project planning and risk mitigation
Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge-sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data-driven decision-making
Qualifications
Essential Qualifications and Education:
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project-driven environment
Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels
About Us
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we've forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.
Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.
Sobre a vaga
Estamos em busca de um Moço de Convés experiente e motivado para atuar em nossa área da Navegação, que compartilhe dos nossos valores contribuindo com exercicio de suas funções com segurança. Essa posição é estratégica para garantir excelência operacional em nossa frota, buscando obter os melhores resultados.

Comprometimento com o Sistema de Gestão Integrado da Empresa, incluindo padrões de SMS e segurança de processo atender às manobras da embarcação, ocupando os postos para os quais tenha sido escalado.
Ajudar na execução das manobras de fundeio, suspender, atracar, desatracar, entrada e saída de diques e quaisquer outras fainas.

Operar os aparelhos de manobra e peso, nas fainas da embarcação (acionar guinchos, suspender e arriar paus de carga, guindastes, preparar cábreas, acunhar e desacunhar escotilhas, colocar dalas, rateiras, defensas e balões no costado, luz de bulbo, cabo de segurança de proa e popa) ou onde se fizer necessário.
Executar os serviços necessários a conservação, tratamento, limpeza e pintura da embarcação, dos paióis (paiol da amarra, conveses, costado, escotilhas, amuradas, escadas, varandas, passarelas, superestruturas, mastros, guindastes, cábreas, gigantes, turcos, tetos, anteparas, balsas, berços, baleeiras, extratores de ar, ventiladores de gola) e dos demais compartimentos de sua responsabilidade.
Executar todas as tarefas determinadas pelo Contramestre da embarcação, tais como limpeza, tratamento, pintura, lubrificação e quaisquer outras rotinas de manutenção do material de convés

Capacidade de seguir cadeias de comando e manter uma postura ética e proativa.

Experiência prévia em apoio maritimo

Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:
Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência

title: Linux Desktop
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
This is an opportunity for an Linux Engineer/Administrator with a passion for Linux and Customer Success to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have a passion for technology and an eagerness to learn, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full Desktop and Server technical stack at Canonical. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers.
Your day to day job is to provide technical expertise, be an excellent communicator and a service-oriented professional. Every day you will have to make judgement calls to prioritise customer issues and maximise your effectiveness. You will also need to set time aside to learn about our new products and technologies and evolve as a professional. You will participate in various training sessions, team gatherings and Company events.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails
Investigate issues reported by customers by researching and escalating issues
Work to resolve complex customer problems related to Canonical's portfolio of products.
Ownership of results: Ensure that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
Engage directly with customers and work collaboratively by phone, ticketing system, and remote sessions to resolve their issues.
Participate in a regular weekend working rotation.
Contribute new knowledge base articles and maintain existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix.
What are we looking for in you
Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)
Experience with Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.)
Troubleshooting experience:
Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.).
Ability to navigate effectively stack traces and logs, and advise on next steps.
Solid understanding of OS and Application level bugs and when to escalate to the correct team.
Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job
Programming fundamentals in any language.
Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Extensive Customer support experience is key:
Customer needs are top priority.
Communicate professionally, emphatically, clearly and set the right expectations.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. title: Interconnection Sales Specialist
description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You'll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work.
Who are we?
Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company, operating over 260 data centers across the globe. Digital leaders harness Equinix's trusted platform to bring together and interconnect foundational infrastructure at software speed. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners and possibilities to scale with agility, speed the launch of digital services, deliver world-class experiences and multiply their value, while supporting their sustainability goals.
A career at Equinix means you will collaborate on work that impacts the world and be surrounded by endless opportunities to learn new skills and grow in varied directions. We embrace diversity in thought and contribution and are committed to providing an equitable work environment that is foundational to our core values as a company and is vital to our success.
Job Summary
The Interconnection Sales Specialist (ICSS) is responsible for driving digital revenue growth by accelerating Fabric, Fabric Cloud Router and Network Edge, and platform adoption across new and existing accounts. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Sales Account Executives, Solution Architects and Technical Account Managers to deliver the full value of Equinix's digital services portfolio.
Responsibilities:
Product Solutions Expertise
Be a digital product and services expert. Sharing your knowledge of industry best practices, our digital service product offerings, and their benefits to customers.
Support building digital expertise and new products growth across field sales. Partner with Sales Account Executives on digital customer fit, pitch, personas, uses cases, common pain points, potential competitors, and how to handle objections.
Actively maintain and grow your expertise in leading transformational technology concepts and methodologies
Build Customer Relationships
Work as a business partner with account teams to develop digital pursuit strategies with customers and partners.
Build relationships with key stakeholders in assigned accounts, prospects, and partners.
Contribute to quarterly business reviews with customers to identify and develop new digital selling opportunities.
Territory and Account Planning
Drive digital prospecting and account growth within existing accounts or new logos with Sales Account Executive.
Partner with Account Executives to identify, qualify, prioritize, and execute digital services strategies for short and long-term pursuit to achieve assigned sales objectives
Analyze customer data and make recommendations on how to maximize the digital services solutions within assigned territory or account segmentation
Product Solution Selling
Work with Account Executives to identify customers' business needs, challenges and technical requirements and matches to Equinix solutions.
Work closely with Solutions Architects to perform presales feasibility assessments to ensure that digital solutions meet the customer requirements.
Define value metrics within the prospects/customers and deliver value assessments
Engage and influence key decision makers within client base.
Facilitate resources necessary to further sales cycle such as Solution Architects, Technical Account Managers, Product, Customer Success, Marketing etc.
Meet or exceed Monthly, Quarterly and Annual sales objectives and revenue quota, constantly working towards team, monthly & quarterly KPI metrics such as pipeline build, revenue attainment, digital bookings and opportunities development.
Pipeline Management
Prioritize list of accounts/prospects for short and long-term pursuit to achieve assigned sales objectives
Provide timely and accurate information to management such as forecasting and opportunity status
Work with Marketing, Channel and Business Development to support the creation and running of campaigns to generate additional pipeline
Negotiation
Works with Sales Account Executive to drive quoting, negotiating, and closing of digital services sales
Support the Account Executive with digital services contracts and serve as a liaison to the legal team.
Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
Language: Advanced/fluent English
Experience: Solid experience in selling enterprise and cloud solutions; selling infrastructure-as-a-service; technical sales and account management
Strong Knowledge of business challenges facing enterprise executives that are driving digital transformation use case adoption
Skills And Attributes
Passionate about infrastructure, interconnection, and the future of technology and software-as-a-service
Digitally savvy and strong sales management background
Excellent relationship building skills with demonstrated ability to build meaningful relationships with Equinix customers, prospects, and internal colleagues
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams

Prover suporte técnico-analítico às operações de trading e à gestão de portfólio de energia da companhia

Manage a variety of viewpoints to build consensus and create positive outcomes for all parties.
Focus on building trusted relationships.
Uphold the company's code of ethics and business conduct.

An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
